t: This is the Artists Rifles War Memorial, a war memorial at the Royal Academy of Arts. It was made by two artists. One is William Drinkwater Gough, a Canadian-born English sculptor who lived from 1861 to 1937. The other is Arthur Ayres, a visual artist born in 1902. The material I have doesn't say more about the memorial itself, so take a moment to look at the work in front of you, and notice the craftsmanship of the two people who made it.
